request: 项目插件需要一键导出指定日期和周一至周日邮件简报，消息汇总版自动提取当前项目相关的新消息，支持复制粘贴。保留现有数据和未保存草稿。
acceptance: 指定日期及周一至周日按北京时间统计
邮件主题/正文可复制并导出可读UTF-8 EML
消息汇总自动调用宿主按项目及日期提取有来源的用户/助手消息
拒绝跨工作区、未声明能力、锁定及过期桥接，不执行发送或模型工具
隔离实例浏览器验收，保留9999数据和旧验收草稿

requirements.summary: User confirmed automatic project-related new messages and Monday-Sunday in Beijing time.

design.summary: Read-only declared capability; explicit project/run provenance and workspace isolation. Actual message timestamps in Beijing time, labeled task-time fallback for legacy messages. No provider call or email sending.

implementation.summary: Added project.messages bridge, durable local message timestamps with legacy-compatible decoding, provider metadata stripping and plugin client method. Existing released main remains unchanged.

verification.summary: Scoped Go race tests passed (29.084s); host JS syntax and diff checks passed. Latest compiled binary restarted on isolated 18492; real API returned two synthetic project-related messages and excluded unrelated project. Safari generated daily and Beijing Monday-Sunday weekly reports, copied subject and combined text with actual paste, downloaded UTF-8 EML and MIME-decoded it successfully. Plugin 111 Python and 53 Node tests passed. Full repository/release gate, narrow-screen layout and external mail client are NOT_RUN.

documentation.summary: Documented capability, scoping, time interpretation, bounded extraction, legacy fallback and no-email-send boundary. Plugin README and verification describe local candidate status.

cleanup.summary: Reviewed explicit scope and diff; kept synthetic fixtures, old drafts, and acceptance evidence. One Safari workbench page remains for review. No production data writes or deployment by this feature.

release.summary: New briefing capability and plugin features are local candidates only. No new version, push, release or 9999 installation was requested for these changes. Existing main RC9 release is separate.

rollback: Stop only aide-annotation-acceptance to retire this isolated candidate; preserve its mounted data. Released main and 9999 remain RC9.
handoff: Host source in separate worktree/branch; plugin risk/history and briefing source local commits. 18492 supports review. Production 9999 does not contain these new features. Further deployment/release requires a new user request and full release gates.
